entry.title: La Gran Oferta Lancero — Box of 20
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, black coffee
entry.summaryHtml: Black cherry, dark chocolate, espresso, malt, toasted oak and black pepper give this lancero a sweeter, rounder My Father profile. The oily Habano Rosado wrapper carries much of the aromatic detail, while the Nicaraguan Habano-Criollo core adds leather, spice and a dry espresso finish through the long 38-ring format.
entry.noteHtml: AuCigars lists the box of 20 at A$666.96 and currently shows the product unavailable.
